description: This file defines an Android activity class 'ComplicationSimpleConfigActivity' used for configuring complications on a watch face in an Android Wear OS application. It manages user interactions for selecting complication providers, displays a list of available complications, and handles external intents related to complication provider selection.

classes.name: ComplicationSimpleConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for configuring watch face complications, allowing selection and setup of complication sources.

classes.name: ComplicationItem
classes.description: A data class representing a complication configuration item, including watch face component, complication ID, supported types, icon, and title.

classes.name: ConfigurationAdapter
classes.description: A custom WearableListView.Adapter that provides views for the complication items list, handling inflating item layouts and binding data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the content view, adapter, and list view click listener.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the provider chooser activity, retrieving selected provider info.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to start provider chooser activity for selected complication.

methods.name: getComplicationItems
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of complication items based on resource arrays and static constants.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on the empty top region of the list (no action implemented).

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the complication item at a given position.
